summary: This clinical study tests how a drug called Henagliflozin affects adults with prediabetes, a condition where blood sugar levels are higher than normal but not yet in the diabetes range. Researchers plan to enroll 984 participants in this Phase 4 trial. Participants will be assigned to receive either Henagliflozin or a placebo, which looks like the drug but has no active medicine, alongside lifestyle changes. Shandong Provincial Hospital is sponsoring the research.
